title: Permutation of edges in mutation reduction of pointed Brauer trees
summary: Aihara developed an algorithm for Brauer tree algebras, which we call a mutation reduction, for getting from a Brauer tree algebra to the simpler Brauer star algebra using a sequence of mutations centered on edges. Schaps and Zvi, using the Schaps-Zakay theory of pointing the tree, showed that different algorithms for the sequence of mutations give permutations of the edges. Kozakai gave a new algorithm for a mutation reduction that depends on a given pointing and describes the evolution of the pointing under the mutation reduction.
